messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The adverse outcomes included more slow heartbeats, low blood pressure, strokes, and deaths.
Triplet: ["Avoiding high dose of extended-release metoprolol before non-cardiac surgery", "has reason", "linked to adverse outcomes in one large trial"]

The relation 'has reason' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is associated with the reason or cause specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be accompanied by': The subject condition or entity may occur alongside or be associated with the condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'caused by': The subject condition is caused by the pathogen or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'can occur when': The condition specified by the subject entity may arise under the circumstances described by the object entity.
D. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
E. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
